description: This file defines the class DefaultEntityType, which is an immutable implementation of the EntityType interface. It provides methods for creating an entity type instance, equality checks, comparison, and string representations of the entity type.

classes.name: DefaultEntityType
classes.description: An immutable class representing the type of an entity, encapsulating a string value and providing comparison and string access methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultEntityType with a non-empty value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare DefaultEntityType instances based on their value.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this entity type with another EntityType lexicographically.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the entity type string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the entity type string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the entity type.
